The YAML validates successfully. Here is the final workflow:

workflow_id: wf_ae_006
steps:
  - id: search_drive_pdfs
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: google_drive_api
      method: GET
      query: "mimeType='application/pdf' and '{{pending_folder_id}}' in parents"
    output: pdf_file_list

  - id: loop_pdf_files
    op: loop_records
    params:
      collection: "{{pdf_file_list}}"
      sub_steps:
        - id: download_pdf
          op: fetch_api
          params:
            endpoint: google_drive_api
            method: GET
            resource: "files/{{current_file.id}}"
            alt: media
          output: pdf_binary

        - id: ai_vision_extract
          op: call_webhook
          params:
            url: "{{ai_vision_api_url}}"
            method: POST
            content_type: application/pdf
            body: "{{pdf_binary}}"
          output: ai_raw_response

        - id: parse_ai_response
          op: validate_schema
          params:
            input: "{{ai_raw_response}}"
            schema: article_extraction_schema
          output: parsed_extraction

        - id: extract_articles
          op: extract_field
          params:
            source: "{{parsed_extraction}}"
            field: articles
            check_multiple: "{{parsed_extraction.es_multiple}}"
          output: article_list

        - id: handle_error_extraction
          op: handle_error
          params:
            on_step: parse_ai_response
            action: flag_and_continue
            notify: admin

        - id: loop_articles
          op: loop_records
          params:
            collection: "{{article_list}}"
            sub_steps:
              - id: normalise_title
                op: transform_json
                params:
                  input: "{{current_article.title}}"
                  operations:
                    - trim
                    - lowercase
                    - normalize_unicode
                output: normalised_title

              - id: match_excel_category
                op: read_database
                params:
                  source: excel_category_spreadsheet
                  lookup_field: title
                  lookup_value: "{{normalised_title}}"
                output: excel_match

              - id: apply_default_category
                op: apply_rule
                params:
                  condition: "{{excel_match}} == null"
                  true_action: set_default_category
                  default_category_uuid: "{{default_category_uuid}}"
                  flag_for_review: true
                output: resolved_category

              - id: flag_no_match
                op: notify_user
                params:
                  condition: "{{excel_match}} == null"
                  recipient: editorial_team
                  message: "No Excel match for article: {{current_article.title}}"

              - id: convert_to_html
                op: format_output
                params:
                  input: "{{current_article.content}}"
                  format: html
                  handle_interview: true
                  detect_format: interview
                output: html_content

              - id: lookup_cms_metadata
                op: fetch_api
                params:
                  endpoint: cms_api
                  method: GET
                  lookups:
                    - type: author
                      name: "{{current_article.author}}"
                    - type: category
                      uuid_source: "{{resolved_category}}"
                    - type: magazine
                      identifier: "{{current_article.magazine}}"
                output: cms_metadata

              - id: get_csrf_token
                op: fetch_api
                params:
                  endpoint: cms_api
                  method: GET
                  path: /session/token
                output: csrf_token

              - id: authenticate_cms_user
                op: authenticate_user
                params:
                  system: cms
                  method: session
                  csrf_token: "{{csrf_token}}"
                  credentials_ref: cms_publisher_credentials
                output: auth_session

              - id: create_paragraph_blocks
                op: loop_records
                params:
                  collection: "{{html_content.sections}}"
                  sub_steps:
                    - id: create_paragraph
                      op: call_webhook
                      params:
                        url: "{{cms_api_url}}/entity/paragraph"
                        method: POST
                        headers:
                          X-CSRF-Token: "{{csrf_token}}"
                          Cookie: "{{auth_session.cookie}}"
                        body:
                          type: text
                          field_body: "{{current_section}}"
                      output: paragraph_entity
                output: paragraph_references

              - id: create_article_node
                op: call_webhook
                params:
                  url: "{{cms_api_url}}/node"
                  method: POST
                  headers:
                    X-CSRF-Token: "{{csrf_token}}"
                    Cookie: "{{auth_session.cookie}}"
                  body:
                    type: article
                    title: "{{current_article.title}}"
                    field_author: "{{cms_metadata.author_id}}"
                    field_category: "{{cms_metadata.category_uuid}}"
                    field_magazine: "{{cms_metadata.magazine_uuid}}"
                    field_paragraphs: "{{paragraph_references}}"
                output: published_article

              - id: log_article_published
                op: log_audit
                params:
                  action: article_published
                  article_title: "{{current_article.title}}"
                  node_id: "{{published_article.nid}}"
                  source_file: "{{current_file.name}}"
                  category_matched: "{{excel_match != null}}"
                  timestamp: "{{now}}"

        - id: move_pdf_to_completados
          op: fetch_api
          params:
            endpoint: google_drive_api
            method: PATCH
            resource: "files/{{current_file.id}}"
            body:
              addParents: "{{completados_folder_id}}"
              removeParents: "{{pending_folder_id}}"

        - id: update_excel_registry
          op: write_database
          params:
            target: excel_registry_spreadsheet
            operation: append
            data:
              file_name: "{{current_file.name}}"
              processed_date: "{{now}}"
              articles_count: "{{article_list.length}}"
              status: completed

        - id: log_file_processed
          op: log_audit
          params:
            action: pdf_file_processed
            file_name: "{{current_file.name}}"
            file_id: "{{current_file.id}}"
            articles_published: "{{article_list.length}}"
            timestamp: "{{now}}"
